children: may test support at $4,262 per ounce, a break below which could open the way toward the $4,220-$4,235 range.
A wave c from $4,371 temporarily stopped around its 86.4% projection level of $4,277. However, this wave is capable of travelling to $4,262, its 100% projection level.
A break above $4,304 may lead to a gain into $4,317-$4,329 range.
